about: Batch 2 (3 Nov 2026), built on batch 1 (reports/greyhound_model.md section 18): the log-BSP target was the best by 0.0034; the weigh-in, the three blocks together and the Plackett-Luce objective helped a little, race_rel2 and the binary objective did not. Here: what adds to the log-BSP model, a softmax reference for the paired comparison, and the log-BSP model on the confirm recipe (fit from 2021 at 0.05) to check the quick recipe ranks as the slow one does; the study on it.
